title: The Sims 2 Legacy Collection
provenance: Reported by kabilza (highball-db#238, 2026-09-27), Apple M4, macOS 26.5, Highball 0.9.33, engine x64-crossover26.3-r11, Wine's own Direct3D, AVX advertised, frame rate limit 60, the steam and vcrun2022 recipes, rated 5 of 5 after 6 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer. AlecAcosta (highball#249): on 0.10.3 (engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r19, Wine's own Direct3D) the game crashed while loading any neighbourhood on an M4 with macOS 27.0.1; after reinstalling with 0.10.10 and default settings it runs, a bit slow until some in-game settings were lowered (2026-10-08).
notes: Reported perfect on Wine's own Direct3D on the Wine 11 engine r11 with the frame rate limit at 60, after a short session on an M4. Nothing was measured here. A second M4 report: crashes loading a neighbourhood on 0.10.3, runs on 0.10.10 with default settings once some in-game settings are lowered.
